answer: Anchor each agent to a utility bill paid on time a year running. First, the agent shows a signed statement from the power company: 12 on-time payments, one meter, one household. Second, the network checks the meter against a registry so one bill never backs two agents. Third, a missed payment flags the agent, and a second drops it until it rebuilds a fresh record. Forging 1,000 agents means 12 months at $60 per bill plus a $150 install each, $870,000 before the first job. Like a falcon returning to its cliff, the audit circles one meter, and a fake's echo betrays it on the onyx ledger.
